answer: The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins are gone. A single receipt answers everything, and it reads Watchmaker gear train mark struck within the clock tower, spelled out as each gear train is a tooth count weighed beside the punch mark. The nadir says who, the sparrow says how much, the wharf says how long — and of the three answers, the farm fears the last one most. No exceptions, no bulk discount: 48258 POA and 15320 minutes, per head, per epoch, paid up front.
